notes.title: Steam Workshop is now live
notes.content:
Hello everyone! "Exit Kun" now has Steam Workshop support.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2915580/
This  workshop is a beta version of the preview, which will be gradually improved as the game is updated. Now players can customize the game’s cutscenes and more!

Of course, it may take a while for player-generated content to appear. However, everyone can experiment and create their own creations! Download the tool now and try it out!

notes.title: Steam Workshop support launching June 24th
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2915580/Steam/
Hello everyone! IKUN is pleased to announce that EXIT KUN will release Steam Workshop support on June 24*. This workshop is a forward-looking Beta version, and we will gradually improve it as the game is updated.

The Steam Workshop is a central hub where player-created content and tools can be published, organized, and downloaded into games. Until then, you can create or experience cutscenes created by other players, so stay tuned!

*The specific time may vary due to time difference.

In addition, the Play Together (split-screen online) gameplay DLC is launched simultaneously. It can be added to the library for free for a limited time.
Whether it is local play or online split-screen play (Steam remote play), this DLC allows you to experience the fun of Kunkun with your IKUN friends.

Currently, this gameplay requires two game controllers to play cooperatively. Please download the DLC manually from the library. This gameplay is still in beta testing and bugs, bugs and gameplay issues are expected.

If you have any questions, please leave a message in the discussion.
Thank you!

notes.title: [1.21 is now live]Solving low-end PC gaming startup issues
notes.content:
By changing the game backend to DX11, this version fixes the problem of low-end computers (such as Intel™ Integrated Graphics) being unable to run the game. If you were unable to play before, you can try it now
Other updates in this release include:
·Improve overall stability
·Fixed several known BUGs
·Solved the problem that achievements could not be triggered stably

For high-end computers, we plan to bring standalone options to run with dx12 in the future.

notes.title: [Unable to start troubleshooter] "Exit kun" is now available
notes.content:
Using outdated drivers can affect performance despite video hardware meeting or exceeding the system requirements of the game you are playing. We recommend checking for driver updates on a regular basis. If you do encounter performance issues, updating your drivers is a good first step in troubleshooting.

Where To Update Your Drivers
For most graphics cards, you will be able to easily download and install the latest drivers from NVIDIA or AMD:
NVIDIA - https://www.nvidia.com/Download/index.aspx
AMD - https://www.amd.com/support
